description: This Java class defines a FreeMarker template transformation for handling content wrapping and caching within the OFBiz framework. It processes content objects, retrieves related content data, and renders wrapped content using specified templates, primarily for web application content processing.

classes.name: WrapSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that wraps content caching logic, fetching content data, and rendering it within specified templates.
